title: The Seed That Would Not Sink
central_conflict: a rare tree seed floated away from the nursery during a spring flood
decisive_choice: a line of fallen leaves showed a quiet backwater where floating objects gathered
resolution: waited beside the backwater, retrieved the seed, and planted it above the flood line
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered a rare tree seed floated away from the nursery during a spring flood before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but they tried to catch it with a net, but the current carried it beneath a narrow bridge; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized a line of fallen leaves showed a quiet backwater where floating objects gathered; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.

With the visiting readers watching, they waited beside the backwater, retrieved the seed, and planted it above the flood line, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

title: The Bells in the Wrong Order

resolution: reordered the bells by pitch and performed the melody before the audience arrived

title: The Picture That Disappeared
central_conflict: the children's outdoor mural began fading before its unveiling
decisive_choice: the new paint had been mixed with water instead of the protective binder
resolution: mixed the remaining pigments correctly and restored the mural beneath a temporary awning
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered the children's outdoor mural began fading before its unveiling before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but they painted another layer, but the colors washed away after a light shower; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized the new paint had been mixed with water instead of the protective binder; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.

With the visiting readers watching, they mixed the remaining pigments correctly and restored the mural beneath a temporary awning, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.
